securityNotes: Read the single SKILL.md in full at the pinned SHA. Prose-only, no scripts in the skill directory. Grep sweep of the whole repo for injection/exfiltration/credential/network/download-execute patterns found only benign design-content matches (curly-quote typography guidance). The repo's npm postinstall scripts (scripts/install.js, scripts/uninstall.js) sit outside every skill directory and were still reviewed line-by-line: they only create/remove symlinks under ~/.claude/skills with backup and ownership checks, no network access. Clean.
overlaps: impeccable (not-vendored-keeper, this pipeline): its audit/critique commands cover similar full-audit ground

proposedEntry.name: design-details
proposedEntry.description: Parent router and full-audit contract for a suite of seven UI-craft sub-skills (animation, layout, copy, typography, color, accessibility, analytics). Enforces a Design System Protocol (check for existing tokens/CSS variables/theme objects before proposing any value; propose additions instead of overrides), a Context Gathering Protocol (audience, use cases, tone, platform - stop and ask if missing, with a /design-details init flow that persists answers to .design-details.md so the interview happens once per project), and a full-audit contract: run every applicable sub-skill, cover a named surface checklist (narrow viewport, modals, error/empty/loading states, keyboard traversal, reduced motion, live regions), open with a scope preamble stating what was and was not audited, and present findings as lettered sections of Before | After | Why tables, closing with an optional row-by-row walkthrough mode (Apply / Decline / Discuss / Stop per item).
inputs: the screen or component under review
outputs: interactive row-by-row walkthrough with applied fixes
